statement: The contract has no memory of fills, so the step that moves the offdeltas for a fill also shrinks the offer to its remainder (give and want, both reservations, the clause in the signed body), and a whole fill leaves no clause. The signed state never carries a clause that could fill what the offdeltas already hold: a dispute from it with the taker filling in full yields exactly the offer, never more, in any order of offers, fills, withdrawals and lapses. The Arrival cell holds the one-Account half: a fill moves the offdeltas and rebuilds the signed clause from what remains (or drops it) in the same step, and a dispute from any reachable state pays the moved offdeltas plus the taker's ratio of what the clause still holds, never more than the offer.
source: Arthur 10-01 02:53 (D3: two-party swap inside an Account); plan/swap-onchain.md; coordinator 10-01
